title: Green microwave synthesis of pyrazole chalcone molecular hybrids efficient route to advanced diabetes therapeutics with DNA intercalative properties.
one_liner_zh: 该文合成吡唑查尔酮衍生物并研究其抗糖尿病活性及与DNA的嵌入结合，虽涉及DNA互作但无AI/物理模拟方法，且非TF-DNA体系，仅分子对接为辅助，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Novel chalcone derivatives incorporating pyrazole moieties were synthesized via microwave assisted Claisen-Schmidt condensation and evaluated for their in vitro alpha-amylase and alpha-glucosidase inhibitory potential as therapeutic agents against diabetes mellitus, a rapidly escalating global health crisis. The microwave-assisted approach demonstrated remarkable synthetic advantages achieving excellent yields (80-85%) and enhanced product purity within minutes compared to conventional methods requiring over 24 hours. Five pyrazole-chalcone hybrids, L(I) (C(19)H(16)N(2)O), L(II) (C(18)H(14)Cl(2)N(2)O), L(III) (C(18)H(14)N(3)O(3)), L(IV) (C(20)H(16)N(2)O(2)), and L(V) (C(18)H(15)N(2)O(2)), were successfully synthesized from pyrazole ketone and different substituted aldehydes. Comprehensive structural characterization using FTIR, NMR, UV-Vis, fluorescence, cyclic voltammetry, and mass spectrometry confirmed successful target compound formation. In vitro enzyme inhibition studies revealed promising dose dependent activity with compounds L(IV) (IC(50) = 212.5 microM) and L(II) (IC(50) = 215.2 microM) demonstrating superior alpha-glucosidase inhibition compared to acarbose (IC(50) = 240.6 microM), while compound L(I) exhibited potent alpha-amylase inhibitory activity (IC(50) = 501.9 microM). DNA binding studies indicated intercalative interactions with binding constants ranging from 10(3) to 10(4) M(-1). Molecular docking analysis revealed stable protein ligand complexes with compound L(II) showing binding affinities of -6.15 kcal mol(-1) for alpha-glucosidase and -5.83 kcal mol(-1) for alpha-amylase, while DFT calculations indicated HOMO-LUMO energy gaps of 3.93-4.30 eV suggesting moderate chemical reactivity. The in silico drug-likeness and oral bioavailability profiles of pyrazole-chalcone fully comply with Lipinski's criteria and exhibit excellent ADMET properties. These comprehensive findings establish pyrazole chalcone hybrids as promising multifunctional molecular scaffolds with significant potential for next-generation antidiabetic therapeutics.
abstract_zh: 通过微波辅助的Claisen-Schmidt缩合反应合成了含有吡唑部分的新型查尔酮衍生物，并评估了其作为治疗糖尿病（一种迅速升级的全球健康危机）的体外α-淀粉酶和α-葡萄糖苷酶抑制潜力。微波辅助方法展示了显著的合成优势，在几分钟内实现了优异的产率（80-85%）和增强的产品纯度，而传统方法需要超过24小时。五种吡唑-查尔酮杂化物，L(I) (C(19)H(16)N(2)O)、L(II) (C(18)H(14)Cl(2)N(2)O)、L(III) (C(18)H(14)N(3)O(3))、L(IV) (C(20)H(16)N(2)O(2))和L(V) (C(18)H(15)N(2)O(2))，成功地从吡唑酮和不同取代的醛合成。使用FTIR、NMR、UV-Vis、荧光、循环伏安法和质谱进行的全面结构表征确认了目标化合物的成功形成。体外酶抑制研究揭示了有希望的剂量依赖性活性，其中化合物L(IV) (IC(50) = 212.5微摩尔)和L(II) (IC(50) = 215.2微摩尔)表现出优于阿卡波糖（IC(50) = 240.6微摩尔）的α-葡萄糖苷酶抑制效果，而化合物L(I)表现出强效的α-淀粉酶抑制活性（IC(50) = 501.9微摩尔）。DNA结合研究表明插入相互作用，结合常数范围在10(3)到10(4) M(-1)之间。分子对接分析揭示了稳定的蛋白质-配体复合物，其中化合物L(II)对α-葡萄糖苷酶和α-淀粉酶的结合亲和力分别为-6.15 kcal mol(-1)和-5.83 kcal mol(-1)，而DFT计算表明HOMO-LUMO能隙为3.93-4.30 eV，提示中等化学反应性。吡唑-查尔酮的计算机药物相似性和口服生物利用度特征完全符合Lipinski规则，并表现出优异的ADMET性质。这些综合发现确立了吡唑-查尔酮杂化物作为有前途的多功能分子支架，在下一代抗糖尿病治疗中具有显著潜力。
